judgedRelations.reason: 三个方法共享同一高层解法：当已给版式中某栏目缺乏材料时，以'不增补无依据内容'为准——空缺处标注待补充或就缺项向用户提问，绝不编造日期、数字或工作成果。method-e34891085d95cf86 把它窄化为固定模板下的缺项处理（'模板中的数据、进展或下周计划若没有对话材料支撑，不要自行补写'、'可留空并注明"待补充"，也可只针对缺项向用户提问'）；method-4cef5fe345997e09 在整体进展汇报中应用同一规则（'模板要求的栏目没有材料支撑时，保留"待补充"或向用户确认，不凭经验虚构'）；method-e75960172b72da3e 在周报/月报写作中应用同一规则（'那一栏留空并标"待补充"，或者问一句；不替用户补写'）。三者是同一模式在不同覆盖面下的实例，可归纳出一个不合并、不取代它们的父方法。

All three methods prescribe the same higher-level pattern for progress-report writing: establish audience and period first, then write only facts the user supplied, leave template columns unsupported by material empty or marked 待补充 (or ask the user), prefer short-and-true over complete-and-fabricated, lead with the conclusion then supporting facts, and keep risks/decisions in a separate block. method-4cef5fe345997e09: '动笔前先确认汇报面向谁、覆盖哪个起止时间' ... '模板要求的栏目没有材料支撑时，保留“待补充”或向用户确认，不凭经验虚构' ... '开头先呈现核心结论或关键事项，随后列出对应事实；风险事项和待决策者单独成块'. method-e75960172b72da3e: '先弄清读者是谁、汇报哪一段时间，再成稿' ... '那一栏留空并标“待补充”，或者问一句；不替用户补写' ... '先写结论或最要紧的一件事，再写支撑它的事实；风险和需要读者拍板的事单独列出'. method-e34891085d95cf86 narrows the same pattern to the missing-column case: '模板中的数据、进展或下周计划若没有对话材料支撑，不要自行补写。对应栏目可留空并注明“待补充”，也可只针对缺项向用户提问。不为了填满模板而编造日期、数字或工作成果。' Three peers sharing one solution pattern; this justifies an abstract parent that summarises how the parts combine, not a merged body and not a replacement.

costs.scope: Token-based conservative peak-rate model estimate (input 2, cached input .04, output 8 CNY/M); not an invoice. Embeddings billed separately. Interrupted pilot requests may have no returned usage receipt; shared balance includes other lanes.

limitations: One draw per arm on public planted libraries; rules repeat across sizes.
Stored-relation recall reads method heads, including retired methods and resolved relation records; judge recall is cumulative over completed decisions.
Harmful merges count known planted nonduplicate pairs named together in a canonical pendingRetirements record; unlabelled pairs are not independently adjudicated.
Direct model-step transport; product LearningService, ProductDocuments, relation writer, queue and PostgreSQL authority. No DSH.
This L4 composition has no native J1 judgeService; the off arm uses screenPairs fallback and both arms are measured without native SCREEN calls.
L4 composes one owned library with no contextProvenance. Namespace-budget rotation is covered by a separate two-scope product test; it is not an L4 measurement.
The off arm retains the legacy 100-method read window in this L4 composition; the native context reader already paginates. These gains do not isolate the six-group limit alone.
Per-arm source digests are retained. Off6 controls predate queue retry-age metadata and merge review, both inactive in the unchanged off path. All on8 proofs use the final guarded policy.

All original planted duplicate pairs paraphrase their applicability fields. The conservative automatic-folding guard therefore withholds their replacement, even when the independent review records a duplicate relation. Canonical-creation counts are reported separately.
Lock hold is time executing the library operation under its PostgreSQL advisory lock; final COMMIT overhead is excluded.
The call allowance controls admission between bounded steps; an admitted repair can finish above it. Actual calls and overrun are reported.
The queued allowance covers DECIDE/BUILD calls. The pre-existing ten-description limit and embedding requests are separate; pass receipts include all model calls.
pendingBuilds counts examined pairs awaiting a follow-up, including an independent merge review deferred by the call allowance, a body build, or the unchanged harm guard.
Retirement policy and active-library cap are unchanged. Superseded/retired snapshots become obsolete; current pair versions are queued.
Old 0.60 calibration applies to the original summary screen, not proof of recall for the union of new retrieval views.
